summary: Software developer with hands-on experience building web and mobile applications, from backend APIs and database schemas to React Native mobile apps and admin panels. Comfortable working across the stack — Postgres schema design, REST APIs, and deployment on a Linux VPS — while collaborating with teams using GitHub for version control and code review.

workExperience.description:
Built the Android and iOS apps for the company's retail platform in React Native, working feature by feature alongside the design team.
Wrote and maintained REST APIs in Node.js and Express to support the mobile app's core flows.
Designed the PostgreSQL schema for the application, including table structure and queries for the admin panel and mobile app.
Built the admin panel used to manage app content, and handled deployment and ongoing maintenance on a Linux VPS.
Collaborated with the team through GitHub, managing pull requests, code reviews, and merge conflicts as part of the regular workflow.

Worked on a live production backend for an industrial client, built with Node.js, Express, TypeScript, and MongoDB.
Added real-time features using Socket.IO for live status updates between connected clients.
Worked on API design and schema changes as the product evolved, and profiled slow endpoints to bring response times down.

Built 3 responsive websites in React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript from Figma-style UI designs.
Turned static designs into mobile-friendly pages, and built 2 additional frontend projects for IT-sector clients.

Built a College Management System in Next.js from scratch, handling both frontend and backend.
Set up role-based access for Admin, Teacher, and Student accounts, each with a different view of the system.
Built out attendance tracking, marks entry, report card generation, and dashboards for each role.
Designed the API layer and database for academic records, and it's still in use for day-to-day academic operations.
